description: This file defines API routes for managing user files, including listing, uploading, and deleting files. It integrates FastAPI, interacts with Supabase for storage and database, handles permissions with user JWTs, and enforces file constraints like size and type.

methods.name: Client get_supabase()
methods.description: Create a Supabase client using environment variables for configuration.

methods.name: str _ext(name: str)
methods.description: Return the file extension of a given filename in lowercase.

methods.name: list_files( session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: List files owned by the current user, optionally filtered by session ID.

methods.name: upload_file( session_id: str = Form(..., description="Target session ID"), upload: UploadFile = File(..., description="File to upload (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .xlsx)"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handle file uploads: validate, store in Supabase Storage, and insert metadata into database.

methods.name: delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Delete a specific file owned by the current user, removing both storage object and metadata.

methods.name: delete_session_file(session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Delete a file associated with a specific session, ensuring ownership and session match.

ctags.name: delete_file
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None):$/
